id.description: Observed null live 2026-08-02 on non-workout itemTypes (e.g. weight/bloodpressure entries). sync.py already handles this — sync_scheduled_workouts skips and logs any item with a null id. Also null on a subscribed shareable event item (verified live 2026-10-12) — sync_calendar_events keys those by shareableEventUuid instead.

itemType.description: Observed values in this account: activity, fbtAdaptiveWorkout, nap, bloodpressure, weight, trainingPlan, event (a Garmin calendar event, e.g. a race — verified live 2026-10-09, consumed by sync_calendar_events). Correction 2026-08-02: fbtAdaptiveWorkout is NOT just an auto-generated suggestion to skip — verified live against a real active coach training plan (trainingPlanId 46457367) that these are the actual coach-assigned future workouts (title e.g. "Base"/"Tempo", sportTypeKey populated, tpType: "FBT_ADAPTIVE"). workoutId is genuinely always null on these; sync_scheduled_workouts now also includes any item with itemType==fbtAdaptiveWorkout and a non-null trainingPlanId. Previous filter (workoutId-only) silently dropped every coach-plan workout — caught because the calendar showed nothing 6-7 days out despite the coach having added items.

tpType.description: "FBT_ADAPTIVE" for coach/training-plan items (itemType fbtAdaptiveWorkout), null for everything else (activity, nap) — verified live 2026-08-08.

activityTypeId.description: null on workout/activity samples; 1 on a running event — verified live 2026-10-09 against a real itemType "event" item with isRace: true; consumed by sync_calendar_events. Only sport signal on event items (sportTypeKey is null there); stored raw, not mapped.

title.description: String on all 20 items of the 2026-10 live capture (activity, fbtAdaptiveWorkout, event, trainingPlan) — verified 2026-10-09; the earlier "observed null in captured sample" note did not hold there. Read as the workout name by sync_scheduled_workouts and as the event name by sync_calendar_events.

date.description: Consumed as scheduled_date (code also falls back to calendarDate, not observed as a real key in this account's items).

weight.description: Observed null live 2026-08-02 on non-weight itemTypes; only populated for itemType=weight entries. Not consumed by sync.py.

difference.description: Observed null live 2026-08-02; paired with weight, not consumed by sync.py.

sportTypeKey.description: Consumed as sport tag. Bug #62 (fixed): code previously read item.get("sport") or item.get("activityType"), neither of which exist — sportTypeKey is the real, flat-string field.

url.description: null on most items; the public event listing URL on a shareable event — verified live 2026-10-12 on a subscribed shareable event (itemType "event", no id); consumed by sync_calendar_events -> url.

isRace.description: null on non-event items; true on an event item marked as a race — verified live 2026-10-09 against a real itemType "event" item with isRace: true; consumed by sync_calendar_events.

startTimeHhMm.description: Local start time, HH:MM (e.g. "08:00"). Read by sync_calendar_events -> start_time_local.

timeZoneId.description: IANA zone (e.g. "America/Chicago"). Read by sync_calendar_events -> time_zone_id.

eventTimeLocal.description: null on non-event items; on an event item: {"startTimeHhMm": "08:00", "timeZoneId": "America/Chicago"} — verified live 2026-10-09 against a real itemType "event" item with isRace: true; consumed by sync_calendar_events.

workoutId.description: One of two filter keys (see itemType) sync_scheduled_workouts uses to decide whether an item is a real scheduled workout. Always null for coach/training-plan items (itemType==fbtAdaptiveWorkout) — populated only for workouts created via create_workout/the Garmin workout builder. No positive (non-null) example captured yet in this account; fbtAdaptiveWorkout items are matched via trainingPlanId instead.

location.description: null on most items; city on a shareable event (e.g. "<city>, CA") — verified live 2026-10-12 on a subscribed shareable event (itemType "event", no id); consumed by sync_calendar_events -> location.

shareableEventUuid.description: null on most items; the only identifier on a shareable event (id is null there) — verified live 2026-10-12 on a subscribed shareable event (itemType "event", no id); consumed by sync_calendar_events -> shareable_event_uuid tag.

value.description: Event distance in `unit` (e.g. 13.11). Read by sync_calendar_events -> completion_target_value.

unit.description: Observed: "mile" (personal event), "meter" (shareable event, 2026-10-12). Only mapped units derive distance_m (_COMPLETION_TARGET_UNIT_M).

unitType.description: Observed: "distance". distance_m is only derived when this is "distance".

completionTarget.description: null on non-event items; on an event item: {"value": 13.11, "unit": "mile", "unitType": "distance"} (a half marathon, rounded to 2dp) — verified live 2026-10-09 against a real itemType "event" item with isRace: true; consumed by sync_calendar_events. Only unit "mile" observed so far; no goal time anywhere in this response.

shareableEvent.description: false on most items; true on a shareable event — verified live 2026-10-12 on a subscribed shareable event (itemType "event", no id); consumed by sync_calendar_events -> shareable_event.

primaryEvent.description: null on non-event items; true on the coach plan's target race — verified live 2026-10-09 against a real itemType "event" item with isRace: true; consumed by sync_calendar_events.

subscribed.description: null on most items; true on a shareable event the account subscribed to — verified live 2026-10-12 on a subscribed shareable event (itemType "event", no id); consumed by sync_calendar_events -> subscribed.

title: Scheduled workouts calendar (get_scheduled_workouts)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_scheduled_workouts(year, month). Consumed by sync_scheduled_workouts, which includes a calendarItem as a real scheduled workout if either (a) workoutId is non-null (workout created via create_workout/the Garmin workout builder), or (b) itemType==fbtAdaptiveWorkout with a non-null trainingPlanId (coach/training-plan-assigned workout — confirmed live 2026-08-02 against an active coach plan, trainingPlanId 46457367). Still no positive fixture for case (a); case (b) is real and verified. No positive fixture yet for a real scheduled/uploaded (case a) workout item (see README gaps).

Verified against: 2026-07 (30 items, 0 with workoutId), 2026-08 (9 items, 0 with workoutId, 6 with itemType==fbtAdaptiveWorkout — the coach-plan items case (b) exists to catch). Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.
